(def array-index-of
  (fn [arr k]
(cond
    ;; The runtime's tests, not the public predicates' calls (#442).
    (suss.bootstrap/keyword? k) (array-index-of-keyword? arr k)

    (suss.bootstrap/string? k)
    (array-index-of-identical? arr k)

    (suss.bootstrap/number? k)
    (let [len (alength arr)]
      (loop [i 0]
        (cond
          (<= len i) -1
          (suss.bootstrap/equiv k (aget arr i)) i
          :else (recur (+ i 2)))))

    (symbol? k) (array-index-of-symbol? arr k)

    (nil? k)
    (array-index-of-nil? arr)

    :else (array-index-of-equiv? arr k))))
